text: This is for my dad, who always goes round the wrong side of the hide and ends up in the reeds. Could we have a path from the door coming down to the bottom of the page, with CAR PARK written at that end? Just a plain line will do. I'd also like a little note beside the pool saying Bittern seen here, 7 Nov. Actually leave the date out, I need to check that in my diary. The bench looks fine. He'll recognise that much, it's where he left his flask.

wires.span: a path from the door coming down to the bottom of the page, with CAR PARK written at that end
Just a plain line will do
a little note beside the pool saying Bittern seen here, 7 Nov. Actually leave the date out

adjudicated.why: A new line is a connect (set is for a line that already exists), and a plain line is arrow=none; the self-correction drops the date.
